svg.title: Architecture
svg.desc: Applications send requests to the gateway, which runs the checks and calls OpenAI, Anthropic or a local Ollama model. The gateway keeps its data in PostgreSQL and Redis. The admin dashboard reaches the gateway's admin API through its own server.
svg.text: Four services in Docker Compose. Applications change two settings: the URL they send to, and the API key.
Admin API /v1/admin: login, logs, review queue, budgets, policies, stats
Fail-closed: if any check breaks, the request is refused, not waved through.
Trained classifier mounted read-only; nothing raw is ever logged or stored.
Its server keeps the session in
